hero.headline: Pharmaceutical-Grade HDPE Bottles & Caps for Regulated Markets
hero.subheadline: ISO-certified HDPE bottles, child-resistant closures and CT caps — manufactured under controlled conditions, delivered on time.

about.title: Precision Packaging Built for Pharma
about.description: Product Armor Packaging Pvt Ltd is a cleanroom manufacturing company based in Hyderabad, India, serving the pharmaceutical industry with HDPE bottles, Child Resistant Closures (CRC) and Continuous Thread (CT) caps. Our 1,820 sq.m ISO Class 8 certified facility combines end-to-end automation, rigorous quality systems and 100% automated inspection to deliver contamination-free, pharma-grade packaging with a low carbon footprint.

products.name: HDPE Pharmaceutical Bottles
products.description: High-density polyethylene bottles manufactured in an ISO Class 8 cleanroom for contamination-free, pharma-grade quality. Available from 30cc to 2400cc across 20 sizes.
features: USP Class VI compliant HDPE resin

products.name: Child Resistant Caps
products.description: Push-down-and-turn child resistant closures manufactured with our patented low-carbon compression moulding technology (Patent No. 568961), meeting global safety standards.
features: CFR 16 Part 1700 compliant, tested to ISO 8317
Pictorial + textual opening instructions on cap tops

products.name: Continuous Thread Caps
products.description: Standard CT closures for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical applications, produced with continuous compression moulding for consistent quality and low carbon footprint.
features: 2D & 3D barcode printing as per client needs
Induction seal, foam and EPE liner options
